LAW AND MOTION 301, RULING - A R G U E D; THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT DAVID YANG'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS GRANTED. DEFENDANT HAS PRESENTED EVIDENCE SHOWING THERE WAS NO BREACH OF DUTY AND THAT THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS HAS RUN. PLAINTIFF HAS FAILED TO RAISE A TRIABLE ISSUE OF MATERIAL FACT OR, INDEED, TO PRESENT ANY EVIDENCE AT ALL AND HAS FAILED TO SUBMIT A SEPERATE STATEMENT DISPUTING ANY FACT ASSERTED BY DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF'S COUNSEL IS DIRECTED TO READ AND COMPLY WITH LOCAL RULE 2.6(B). THE COURT ALSO FINDS THAT IT IS INAPPROPRIATE TO GRANT LEAVE TO AMEND AT THIS POINT OF THE CASE. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER PURSUANT TO CCP 437 C(G). JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 (301/PJB)
